name: dolutegravir
warnings: 5 WARNINGS AND PRECAUTIONS • Hepatotoxicity has been reported in patients receiving a dolutegravir-containing regimen. Monitoring for hepatotoxicity is recommended. interactions: 7 DRUG INTERACTIONS Coadministration of TRIUMEQ or TRIUMEQ PD with other drugs can alter the concentration of other drugs and other drugs may alter the concentrations of TRIUMEQ or TRIUMEQ PD. The potential drug-drug interactions must be considered prior to and during therapy. ( 4 , 7 , 12.3 ) 7.1 E
contraindications: 4 CONTRAINDICATIONS TRIUMEQ and TRIUMEQ PD are contraindicated in patients: • who have the HLA-B*5701 allele [see Warnings and Precautions ( 5.1 )] . • with prior hypersensitivity reaction to abacavir
